1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not substantially reduce embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __without prior removal of the embryos from the medium__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __to determine genetic information about the embryos prior to germination__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __that was subjected to steps (a) through (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitation is performed for a duration sufficient to release cellular material without disrupting embryo tissue viability__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __a sequence of steps comprising__: exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are __performed in multiple sequential cycles__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __a sequence of steps comprising__: heating of the shed cellular material and agitation.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are __performed in multiple sequential cycles__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall-degrading__ enzyme.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __isolating and purifying__ the DNA __from the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said __isolating and purifying__ is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and using magnetic separation to isolate DNA-containing complexes__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __at a developmental stage prior to full maturation__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos __in a quiescent state__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __performed to determine__ genotyping __information__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __and wherein the genotyping results are obtained prior to germination of the embryos__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, __selective__ whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __the determined__ genotype __prior to germination__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __based on the genotype selection__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos __based on genotype__ is automated.
